memory_update.text: Murata MRAAY should be treated as the primary US-tradable reference leader for AI-server high-end MLCC exposure, but transcript-level validation of the 15,000-25,000 MLCCs per AI server claim is still needed.
TDK TTDKY has strong direct evidence from official TDK AI data-center MLCC and FY2026 investor materials; classify as reference leader rather than underfollowed small/mid-cap.
Yageo YAGOY/YAGO.Y is a promising underfollowed OTC discovery candidate for AI-server high-capacitance MLCCs, but ticker format, liquidity, and AI-server revenue concentration need confirmation.

US-listed small/mid-cap pure plays in high-end AI-server MLCCs appear scarce; the underfollowed lane may need to expand in later layers to non-US ordinaries, upstream dielectric powders, distributor inventory data, and component testing/certification bottlenecks.

Vishay VSH is a speculative-shadow candidate: US-listed, mid-cap, and relevant to passive components, but current evidence only supports generic MLCC capability, not AI-server-qualified high-end MLCC exposure.

node: High-end MLCCs for AI server boards and rack-scale accelerator systems
summary: Expanded the US-tradable universe for the AI-server high-end MLCC node. The strongest direct-reference names are OTC ADRs of Japanese and Taiwanese passive-component leaders, especially Murata and TDK. The underfollowed discovery lane is thinner in the US-listed universe; Vishay is included as a speculative NYSE-listed passive-component candidate because it sells MLCCs and high-reliability ceramic capacitors, but its AI-server-qualified exposure needs verification. This pass intentionally avoids filling the list with AI accelerator mega-cap customers because the node is a component bottleneck rather than the accelerator demand layer.
